name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on ordinary computer chips instead of expensive specialized hardware, so you can deploy AI features without a huge cloud bill.
buyer: An edge-AI startup or device manufacturer, such as smart cameras or retail kiosks, that needs AI to run locally on cheap hardware instead of paying for cloud inference.
business_use_cases: A smart-retail startup runs in-store people-counting or shelf-monitoring AI directly on in-store PCs instead of paying ongoing cloud API costs.
A security-camera vendor bakes local AI object detection into their devices to avoid per-camera cloud subscription fees.
A consulting firm offers 'cut your AI inference bill' audits that redeploy a client's existing models onto their own hardware.

money_ideas.idea: One-off migration consulting to move a client's cloud AI inference to local or edge hardware
Licensing a packaged edge-AI hardware-and-software bundle to device makers

steal_this: Offer one small business already paying for an AI image or video API a 'we'll cut your AI bill' audit this weekend.
